title: F-8: one or two messages to you per release?
body: ADR 0055 says each release asks you one message. The procedure plans up to two: the first, before the verdict, asks about lapsed decision items and any claim-set change; the second, after the verdicts, asks about each failing clause without a standing acceptance (at 0.4.0: V14 (b)). An empty message is not sent.
One message after the verdicts would bring back the `BLOCKED` row and 0.3.0's re-judgement round.

options.label: Two, the first only when non-empty
